clue.text: Comeuppance here as peckers down?

parts.note: the saying for deserved retribution, pictured literally as hens settling on their perch for the night

explanation.surface: A query about whether the birds that peck are getting their just deserts as they settle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Peckers' are hens, and 'down' is them bedding down for the night; the proverb means bad deeds rebound on the doer.
explanation.definitionFit: The proverb says misdeeds eventually rebound on whoever did them, which is exactly a comeuppance.

clue.text: Artist's fancy couture a sell- out

definitions.note: read as artist is, linking to the wordplay

indicators.note: fancy here means elaborate or reworked, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A painter's elaborate haute couture show has sold out.
explanation.walkthrough: Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec painted Paris cabaret life in the 1890s.
explanation.definitionFit: The French post-impressionist painter of the Moulin Rouge posters is a famous artist.

clue.text: Musk used by eastern church is rank

indicators.note: Musk is taken up by the preceding pieces, so his name follows them

parts.note: Elon Musk, the tech billionaire, supplies his first name

explanation.surface: A billionaire being employed by an Orthodox church sounds a rank idea.
explanation.definitionFit: An echelon is a level or grade in an organisation, a synonym of rank.

clue.text: Well or nearly ill in selfless advice to physician

indicators.note: in places the shortened word within the other piece

parts.note: the saying 'Physician, heal thyself' gives HEAL THYSELF; without SELF it leaves HEAL THY

indicators.note: nearly means the word ill loses its last letter

explanation.surface: A sick doctor told to look after themselves without any selfishness.
explanation.walkthrough: The advice is the proverb 'Physician, heal thyself'; 'selfless' strips SELF from it. 'Nearly' drops the last L of 'ill', and 'in' sets what remains within.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something well can mean doing it in good health, the adverb of being healthy.

clue.text: Socialist constrained by firm principles

indicators.note: constrained by puts the socialist inside the firm's letters

parts.note: CO, short for company, is a firm
a red is a left-winger or socialist

explanation.surface: A left-wing activist held back by a company's firm principles.
explanation.definitionFit: A credo is a set of beliefs or guiding tenets, so it stands for principles.

clue.text: T'cockney?

parts.note: the letter T ends the word East; a cockney Londoner from the East End is one too

explanation.surface: A dialect-looking fragment, as if a cockney dropped a letter.
explanation.walkthrough: A cockney is a working-class Londoner from the East End; the apostrophe makes T look clipped speech but it is the final letter of 'East'.
explanation.definitionFit: Both readings fit: a native of London's East End, and the closing letter of the word East.

clue.text: Steps in sauce

definitions.meaning: the Latin dance whose moves are a set of steps
the spicy tomato relish of Mexican cooking

explanation.surface: Dance steps taken in a sauce, as if someone were cooking while dancing.
explanation.definitionFit: One word names both a lively Latin dance and a chunky Mexican relish of tomato and chilli.

clue.text: On the back of awful tirades

indicators.note: awful suggests the tirades are a mess, so their letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: One rant following hard on another, terrible ones at that.
explanation.definitionFit: Sitting astride a horse means sitting on its back, legs either side.

clue.text: Anticipate covering even half botched nose job regardless of cost

indicators.note: covering means the first word wraps around the rest

parts.note: to anticipate is to expect

indicators.note: half takes the second two of the four letters of even
botched says the letters of nose job are bungled into a new order

explanation.surface: A patient expecting a bodged rhinoplasty to be redone whatever the bill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Half' takes the back half of 'even'; 'botched' gives SENOOBJ from 'nose job'; 'covering' wraps the anticipating word around both.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom says money is no obstacle, meaning one spends without worrying about price.

clue.text: Lift with spinner remarkably unapprehensive?

indicators.note: remarkably signals that the letters of unapprehensive are rearranged, once spinner's letters are set aside

explanation.surface: A spin bowler being boosted, remarkably free of worry.
explanation.walkthrough: A composite anagram: SPINNER plus the answer make the letters of UNAPPREHENSIVE.
explanation.definitionFit: To heave something up is to raise it, so the verb is a synonym of lift.

clue.text: That would put Dubrovnik down for divorce

definitions.meaning: the Croatian city Split lies up the coast from Dubrovnik, so with ..., Dubrovnik is below

explanation.surface: Something that would humiliate the Croatian city, offered as grounds for a marriage ending.
explanation.walkthrough: Split and Dubrovnik are both cities on Croatia's Adriatic coast, Split to the north.
explanation.definitionFit: Couples who separate are said to break up, a phrasal verb equivalent to divorcing.

clue.text: Towel round hooter

indicators.note: round suggests the letters of the word are turned about into a fresh order

explanation.surface: A towel wrapped round someone's nose, hooter being slang for nose.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hooter' looks like slang for a nose but here means a bird that hoots.
explanation.definitionFit: A young owl is something that hoots, so it is playfully a hooter.

clue.text: Choice includes time for surgery

indicators.note: includes means the choice's letters hold the time inside them

parts.note: an option is a choice
an era is a period of time

explanation.surface: Choosing when to have surgery, the patient's decision taking time into account.
explanation.definitionFit: A surgical procedure is commonly called an operation.

clue.text: Tanned and sent down having changed sides

parts.note: a ship sent down to the seabed is sunk

indicators.note: changed means the letters of sides are rearranged

explanation.surface: A beaten player relegated after switching teams.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tanned' looks like thrashed, and 'sent down' like jailed or relegated; ISSED is 'sides' rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Skin bronzed by sunshine is described as kissed by the sun.

clue.text: This form of Islam isn't tyranny

indicators.note: form of says the letters are reshaped into another arrangement

explanation.surface: A statement that this version of a religion is not oppressive.
explanation.definitionFit: The Soviet dictator's system of rule is a byword for despotic oppression.

clue.text: Topic those people finally raise

parts.note: them refers to those people

indicators.note: finally picks the closing letter of raise

explanation.surface: A subject that a group eventually brings up.
explanation.definitionFit: The subject of a talk or essay is its topic.

clue.text: Conflict to recover old Jerusalem as initiated by Sadat

indicators.note: initiated takes the opening letter of each of the four words

parts.note: Anwar is the forename that stands beside Sadat in the Egyptian president's name

explanation.surface: A Middle East war launched by the Egyptian leader to regain the old city.
explanation.walkthrough: Anwar Sadat was president of Egypt in the 1970s.
explanation.definitionFit: The legendary siege of Troy is a famous conflict from Greek myth.

clue.text: See baby without the presence of a pressure group

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look or see

indicators.note: without the presence of means a letter is taken out of baby

explanation.surface: An instruction to view an infant when no adult is there.
explanation.definitionFit: A lobby is an organised group campaigning to influence lawmakers.

clue.text: Flower (around two seconds)

indicators.note: around means the flower's letters wrap about the pair

parts.note: a bloom is a flower
S is the abbreviation for second, twice

explanation.surface: A flower that lasts only a moment, as if about two seconds.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines and builds the answer: a bloom wrapped round two S's is itself a flower.
explanation.definitionFit: Blossom is the flowers of a tree or shrub, so it is a flower.

clue.text: A patriot upset by love for vegetable

indicators.note: upset means the letters of a patriot are tipped over into a new order

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, shaped like the letter O

explanation.surface: A nationalist annoyed at being beaten to love, or by love, in a vegetable plot.
explanation.walkthrough: The air potato is a tropical yam that bears tubers on its vine.
explanation.definitionFit: This climbing yam produces edible aerial tubers, so it is a vegetable.

clue.text: Green party not quite as vocal to begin with

indicators.note: to begin with takes the opening letter of as
not quite means vocal is cut short by its final letter

parts.note: a do is a party

explanation.surface: An environmental party that's not quite as outspoken as before.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Green party' reads as the political party, but 'Green' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Avocado is a shade of yellowish green, named after the fruit's flesh.

clue.text: Dispatching other half of uncovered Medicis iron axe due to be returned

indicators.note: to be returned means the gathered letters are read backwards
uncovered strips the outer letters from each of the four words

explanation.surface: A Renaissance Medici plot involving an iron axe, with a killing in view.
explanation.walkthrough: Inner letters EDICI, RO, X and U make EDICIROXU, which read backwards gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: The killing of one's wife, one's other half, is the meaning of this Latin-derived word.

clue.text: Taking flower to hospital said to be lucky

indicators.note: to means the hospital letter is attached after the flower

parts.note: the iris is a flower
H is the map abbreviation for hospital

explanation.surface: Bringing a bouquet to a hospital patient is thought to bring luck.
explanation.walkthrough: The phrase 'the luck of the Irish' makes the nationality proverbially lucky.
explanation.definitionFit: The proverbial 'luck of the Irish' makes this nationality one reputed to be fortunate.

clue.text: Young partner and artist

definitions.meaning: ... is the partner of Young in the accountancy firm ... & Young

explanation.surface: A youthful spouse who paints.
explanation.definitionFit: The accountancy firm pairs this name with Young, and Max of that surname was a surrealist painter.

clue.text: Mum finally in a hairstyle that could be a deterrent

indicators.note: in places that letter inside the haircut

parts.note: a bob is a short haircut

indicators.note: finally picks the closing letter of Mum

explanation.surface: A mother's haircut so severe it might scare people off.
explanation.definitionFit: Atomic weapons are held as a nuclear deterrent against attack.

clue.text: Composer somewhat cross initially

indicators.note: somewhat says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A composer who starts off rather irritable.
explanation.definitionFit: Gioachino of this surname wrote operas such as The Barber of Seville.

clue.text: Music genre that's still around as world war starts to recede

indicators.note: to recede means the whole is drawn backwards
around wraps the still word about those letters

parts.note: even can mean still, as in even better

indicators.note: starts takes the opening letter of each of the three words

explanation.surface: A style of music that persists while memories of a global war fade.
explanation.walkthrough: AWW goes inside EVEN to make EVAWWEN, which read backwards gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: The late-1970s post-punk pop movement is a recognised style of music.
